units.name: Department of Tamil
units.title: Department of Tamil — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Tamil — School of Tamil, Indian Languages and Rural Arts. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile: The Department of Tamil has been functioning since the establishment of the Institute. When the Institute was declared as Deemed University in 1976, the Department of Tamil was upgraded into a School of Tamil, Indian Languages and Rural Arts. Part-I Language Tamil is being offered as a compulsory subject to students of all Degree programmes of the Institute. PG programme in Tamil and Indian Literature is also being offered from 1984. Ph.D. Programme in Tamil was started in the year 1990. M.Phil. Programme in Tamil was started in the year 2008. Comparative Indian Literature, Translation, Folklore and Media Studies are the thrust areas of research and instruction. Established a museum on National Poet Subramaniya Bharathiyar in the year 2016. Recently Research Centres on Diaspora Studies, Tribal Languages and Cultural Research and Indian Knowledge System has been established.

units.name: Department of Hindi
units.title: Department of Hindi — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Hindi — School of Tamil, Indian Languages and Rural Arts. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
The Gandhigram Rural Institute was started in 1956. Hindi training programmes were conducted in GRI from the beginning. The University Grants Commission, New Delhi in 1976 conferred GRI the status of Deemed University and the Department of Hindi is functioning under the School of Tamil, Indian Languages and Rural Arts.
The Department of Hindi has got full-fledged Department status since 2004. Gandhigram Rural Institute is the only Institute which has been following three languages formula in Tamil Nadu. Core-Hindi is a compulsory paper and all the UG and 5yr.Int. students must pass Core-Hindi paper to qualify for the degree. Apart from UG Courses Department of Hindi offers M.A. Hindi, Ph.D. Programmes and Certificate Course in Spoken Hindi also. The thrust areas of research are Language Teaching, Comparative Studies and Translation.

units.name: Centre for Malayalam
units.title: Centre for Malayalam — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Centre for Malayalam — School of Tamil, Indian Languages and Rural Arts. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
Malayalam as a language has been taught to students of the Gandhigram Rural Institute since its inception.
In the beginning, Malayalam language was taught under Part - I course to under graduate students besides offering Certificate programme in Functional Malayalam to the staff, students and also others.
Since the introduction of Choice Based Credit System (CBCS), basic Malayalam has been offered as one of the Non - Major Electives to the post-graduate students across the Schools/ Departments.
Duly considering the significance of Malayalam language, a separate entity namely Centre for Malayalam Studies (CMS) was established in October 2017 under the School of Tamil, Indian Languages & Rural Arts.

units.name: School of English & Foreign Languages
units.title: School of English & Foreign Languages — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: School of English & Foreign Languages — School of English & Foreign Languages. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile: The School of English and Foreign Languages is as old as the Gandhigram Rural Institute (GRI) and offers a Master's programme in English and Communicative Studies and full- and part-time PhD programmes in English. Apart from these programmes, a Certificate Course in French is being conducted by the School. It has been a pioneer in introducing innovative programmes, especially in the field of Communicative and Cultural Studies. It ran a Master's programme in Comparative Literature and Cultural Studies, a UGC Innovative Programme from 2005-10. It has so far produced 89 PhDs and more than 150 MPhils. The members of the School serve on various Boards of Studies and other bodies of higher learning in different universities throughout the country. The School brings out Gandhigram Literary Review (ISSN: 2278-8170), a peer-reviewed, annual journal and it is distinct. Every year it conducts Bridge Course for students coming to the Institute for UG Programmes and the curriculum is designed and revised according to the need. For fulfilling the NEP norms, the school designs the curriculum to meet out the rural, regional, national and global demands. It takes care of their (both UG and PG students) skill enhancement by offering Soft Skills and Communication Skills. The PG English students involve in undertaking field visits, internships, NSS and VPP stay camps and their commitments show their care for the village peasants’ livelihood.

units.name: Department of Rural Development
units.title: Department of Rural Development — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Rural Development — School of Health Sciences and Rural Development. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
The Department of Rural Development (DRD) is functioning under the School of Health Sciences and Rural Development, Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram. The Department offers academic programmes namely M.A. in Rural Development Studies (RDS) and Ph.D.
The above said programmes intends to prepare individuals capable of informed and thoughtful development action, empowered with awareness of the complexity, having depth of the discourse on rural development and contributing for policy and action with special reference to the Indian context. Further, an important feature of the above programmes are that it attempts to equip the students with training in skills that they can put to use in any challenging situation either in the ¬field or in the policy sphere. The students are enabled to make smooth transitions from the world of studentship to the world of trained work.

units.description: Centre for Geoinformatics — School of Health Sciences and Rural Development. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile: The Centre for Geoinformatics offers a two-year, four semester M.Sc. programme in Geoinformatics as well as a one-year, two- semester PG Diploma programme in Spatial Technologies, with the aim of developing human resources in Geoinformatics for the emerging, high-tech enterprise scenario in India.

units.name: Department of Applied Research
units.title: Department of Applied Research — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Applied Research — School of Health Sciences and Rural Development. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile: Department of Applied Research, established in 1976 under the Faculty of Rural Development, plays a key role in enabling the Institute to achieve its overall objective of rural development by promoting interdisciplinary, problem-solving, and development research. The department offers B.A. (Hons) in Demography and Development Studies, PG Diploma in Applied Gerontology, and Ph.D. programmes apart from teaching Research Methods and Applied Statistics courses to UG, PG, and Ph.D. programmes of the Institute. The thrust areas of academia are Interdisciplinary and Policy Research, Human Rights and Labour Research, Gender Issues and Emancipatory Research, Population and Reproductive Health, Ecological and Development Indicators, Rural and Tribal Health & Qualitative and Trans-disciplinary Research.

units.name: Department of Rural Health and Sanitation
units.title: Department of Rural Health and Sanitation — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Rural Health and Sanitation — School of Health Sciences and Rural Development. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
The Pilot Health Project,initiated by the Government of India to study rural health conditions, recommended the establishment of training centres for training peripheral-level health personnel. Based on this recommendation, the Department of Rural Health and Sanitation was established in 1961 in Gandhigram Rural Institute as one of the three centres established in the country during that time. The main emphasis in the curriculum is on field training, with a primary focus on rural health and sanitation.
The Department has been offering a PG Diploma in Sanitary Inspector Programme, which caters to the manpower needs of the local panchayats, municipalities, corporations and the Indian Railways in the fields of Health Inspectors and Food Inspectors. As of now, all the students who completed the programme are working in Tamil Nadu.

units.name: Department of Sociology
units.title: Department of Sociology — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Sociology — School of Social Sciences. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
Established in the year 1956, the Department of Sociology has been facilitating the students to study communities adopting instruction, research and extension modes from cultural anthropological and feminist perspectives and equip them with the necessary skills to tackle social issues and preserve native culture.
Teaching and research in Sociology at Gandhigram is also old as Gandhigram Rural Institute (GRI) itself. Teaching, research and extension activities by the faculty members specialized in the subject of Sociology had begun since the inception of the Institute in the year 1956. The present full-fledged Department of Sociology emerged after the conferment of the Deemed to be a University Status by UGC in the year 1976.
Since then, the Department of Sociology has been at the forefront of social science education in Gandhigram Rural Institute, offering in its early days inter-disciplinary Post Graduate Programmes of Rural Services, Rural Sociology and Panchayati Raj, Rural Sociology and currently offering M.A in Sociology and M.Phil (Development Sociology). Besides these, the Department is also offering Sociology Courses in other Departments like Political Science and Development Administration, Rural Development, Rural Technology Centre, Faculty of Agriculture and Animal Husbandry, Faculty of English and Foreign Languages and M.Tech (Renewable Energy) programme of Rural Energy Centre(REC).
The Department has been vigorously promoting sociological research through its Ph.D and PDF programmes, through its numerous research projects funded by national and international agencies and by organising several State, Regional and National Level Seminars, Workshops and Symposia focusing on marginalized communities and their empowerment.
The Department has a very active extension component and right from its genesis has been working with communities in the neighbouring villages, conducting a massive Campaign Again Female Infanticide in Tamil Nadu (CAFIT), sponsored by MHRD, GOI, and TNSAC-sponsored training programmes on Prevention and Control of HIV/AIDS for NGO Personnel.
In all these three aspects, namely, Teaching, Research and Extension, the Department’s focus is on the rural communities and the most marginalized and deprived among them. This is reflected in the courses offered, curriculum design, focus areas for research, and in the nature of its extension works. In tune with the changing times and societal needs, the thrust areas of research and teaching have been centered around Sociology of Development, Inclusive Policy Studies, Gerontology, Poverty, Media Studies and Population Studies.
In keeping with the foundational principles of GRI, the Department aspires to instill social consciousness and service mentality in the wards of the department and groom them as leaders, innovators, social entrepreneurs and academics who would effectively contribute to the overall development of their communities and village and eventually to the whole nation.

units.name: Department of Education
units.title: Department of Education — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Education — School of Social Sciences. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
VISION
Developing Committed, Competent Teachers and Teacher Educators for the promotion of knowledge society.
MISSION
Creating teachers with updated knowledge and innovative skills in teaching through instruction and training.
Undertaking research in teacher education to address the challenges of 21st century.
Developing village schools as foundations of knowledge society in rural areas through knowledge sharing and extension.
The Department of Education, Gandhigram Rural Institute is a Teacher Education Department with reputation as a leading centre for Teaching, Training, Educational Research and Extension.
The Department of Education at Gandhigram Rural Institute is a reputed department for teacher education, recognized for its pioneering efforts in teaching, training, educational research and extension. It actively aligns with the norms and polices of the National Education Policy (NEP- 2020) of India. The Department of Education (DoE) creates empowered, reflective, ethical educators who are capable of transforming the rural educational landscape through inclusive, innovative and learner-centred practices, thereby contributing to the holistic development of individual and the nation. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (GRI) is granted with recognition by the NCTE to offer the B.Ed Integrated Course under the Choice Based Credit System from the year 2003-2004, onwards. The GRI is granted with recognition by the NCTE to offer the M.Ed degree course under the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) 2008-2009 onwards. The students are admitted to the M.Ed Programme through an All-India Entrance Examination conducted at Gandhigram Rural Institute. The Department of Education so far produced 20 batches of B.Ed Teacher Trainees and 15 batches of M.Ed scholars. Twenty-five Ph.D. scholars completed and nineteen Ph.D. scholars are at present pursuing research in the major thrust areas of Educational Research. The vision of the Department is to develop and sustain quality in teacher education programmes by integrating the current knowledge and pedagogical principles with the basic education programme propounded by Mahatma Gandhiji.

units.profile: The Centre for Futures Studies was established in 1989 to promote research in multi-disciplinary areas relevant to Rural Development. The centre has undertaken M.Phil. / Ph.D. / Project research in the filed of Futures Studies, Agriculture, Ethno Botany, Tribal Studies and Environmental Studies. The course Environmental Studies is being offered to all undergraduates of this institute from 2003.

units.name: Department of Rural Industries & Management
units.title: Department of Rural Industries & Management — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Rural Industries & Management — School of Management Studies. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
Department of Rural Industries and Management is one of the oldest Departments in Gandhigram Rural Institute. It was established in the year 1956 as a training centre in rural industries for preparing and training man power in techno managerial cadres. Then it became a centre for Higher learning in rural industries. The Programmes offered in the department are approved by AICTE.
The Department is unique in the university system as it offers programmes related to Rural Industries and Management which are quite inter disciplinary in nature. The programmes of the department deal with industrial processing and technology, Studies on functional areas of management and conducting research in enhancing overall performance of rural / small scale industries.

units.name: Department of Economics
units.title: Department of Economics — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Economics — School of Management Studies. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile: Established in the year 1956, the Department has the vision of Excellence in Education, Research and Extension towards integrated and prosperous rural economy. The Department offers programmes and courses in Economics and its branches, conducts need based rural economic research surveys and studies, organizes seminars and workshops and undertakes outreach and consultancy activities in economics. The thrust areas include Academia of Rural Finance and Banking. Energy Economics, Environmental Economics, Resource Economics, Development Economics, International Economics, Agricultural Economics, Health Economics, Gender Economics and Demographic Studies

units.name: Department of Cooperation
units.title: Department of Cooperation — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Cooperation — School of Management Studies. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile: The Department of Cooperation was established in 1956. It is one of the oldest Departments in Gandhigram Rural Institute. It is the first of its kind in offering Cooperation as an academic discipline at University level in India with the basic objective of developing manpower with updated knowledge and skill in managing, facilitating, organizing, and revitalizing cooperatives and other organizations particularly in rural areas.

units.name: Department of Mathematics
units.title: Department of Mathematics — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Mathematics — School of Sciences. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
The Department of Mathematics was established in the year 1965 and Diploma in Rural Service (Mathematics) was offered till 1975. Then B.Sc. Mathematics programme is being offered from 1976 onwards, Two year PG programme M.Sc. Mathematics is being offered from 2008-2009 onwards. Ph.D. programme is being offered from 1992-1993 onwards. B.Sc., B.Ed. in Mathematics is being offered from the academic year 2018-19. From 2024 onwards B.Sc. (Hons) Mathematics programme is being offered under New Education Policy.
The major research fields being carried out in this Department are Stability Problems of dynamical Systems, including Neural Networks, Fractal Theory and its applications, Optimization in Marketing related problems, Control theory, Graph Theory, Algebraic Graph Theory and Quantum Computing Algorithms. The Department has published more than 820 research articles in SCI journals with SCOPUS citations of more than 14270. So far the Department of Mathematics produced 102 Ph.Ds. Additionally department has 10684 books for the student accessible in the Library supported by UGC-SAP, DST-FIST, NBHM, etc. Since 1997, faculty members are receiving funds from various funding agencies including UGC, NBHM, CSIR and DST-SERB for research and developments. As a result of consistent performance in research, the Department is upgraded with UGC - SAP (DSA-I). International-level research collaborations are being undertaken with Deakin University, Australia, University of Technology, Sultanate of Oman, UAE, Institute of Mathematical Sciences, University of Malaya, Malaysia, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, Yonsei University, South Korea, United Arab Emirates University, UAE, University of Texas at Arlington, Texas, USA, Pusan / Kunsan National Universities, South Korea and UCSI University, Malaysia. So far the Department has successfully conducted 22 International/National Conferences/Seminars/Workshops. In addition to that the Department successfully completed 28 funded projects. Every year the Department celebrates National Mathematics Day and an Intercollegiate Math fest Competitions organized by the Students Association.

units.name: Department of Physics
units.title: Department of Physics — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Physics — School of Sciences. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
To provide higher education for rural children, Ganndhgiram Rural Institute was initiated in 1956. In 1965, the department of Physics blossomed into an independent entity and was offering Diploma in Rural Services with Mathematics and Chemistry as allied subjects with Physics as core subject. The examinations were conducted by the National Council for Rural Higher Education, New Delhi and the DRS was awarded.
In 1976, the Gandhigram Rural Institute was elevated to the status of a Deemed University and the Department started offering and issuing B.Sc. Degree programme in Physics with Chemistry and Mathematics as allied subjects. Considering the need for offering the PG programme in Physics, the Department of Physics offered M.Sc. Degree programme in Applied Physics in 1987. This Degree programme was later in 1994 renamed as M.Sc. (Physics). The Department started admitting students to the Ph.D. programme in 1991 and M.Phil Degree in Physics during the academic year 2009-10 and thereafter.

units.name: Department of Chemistry
units.title: Department of Chemistry — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Chemistry — School of Sciences. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
The Department of Chemistry, established in the year 1965, offers 
B.Sc. Chemistry, M.Sc. Chemistry and Ph.D. Programmes. Under NEP, from the year 2024-25, a 4-year B.Sc. (Hons.) programme is offered. The Department undertakes funded research projects in major areas of chemistry from all leading funding agencies. The faculty members of the department have published over 1100 research papers in peer-reviewed journals, with an h-index of 85 and citations of about 30,423. So far, 169 scholars have been awarded doctoral degrees from the department. The Department is supported by DST-FIST and UGC-SAP. Very recently, the Department of Chemistry has been granted Rs. 2.2 Crore by the DST-FIST Level B in 2024.The Department also carries out extension activities like Defluoridation, Science Teaching, Tree Plantation, etc., Alumni of the Department occupy pivotal positions in industries/institutions both in inland/abroad. The Department has excellent instrumental facilities, including FT-NMR and HR-MS. The Department Library is managed by the students. Resonance is the Chemistry Fest organised by the students of the Department.

units.name: Department of Biology
units.title: Department of Biology — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Biology — School of Sciences. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile: The Department was established during 1978 offering B.Sc., Programme in Microbiology (4 years Hons.); PG Programmes in M.Sc., Botany; M.Sc., Zoology & M.Sc., in Microbiology and Ph.D. Programmes in Botany, Zoology & Microbiology; carrying out Research in the field of Aquaculture, Mushroom Culture, Vermiculture, Ethnobotany, Solid Waste Recycling, Biodiversity, Bio-nanotechnology, Environmental Studies; Plant Taxonomy, Plant Reproductive Biology and Conservation Biology; Transforming Technologies for Rural Development through Extension.

units.name: Department of Home Science
units.title: Department of Home Science — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Home Science — School of Sciences. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
The Department was established in the Year 1956. The department offered a three 
years Diploma in Rural Services in Home Science till 1976. When the Institute becomes a 
Deemed University, the nomenclature was changed to B.Sc Home Science. Towards 
progress the Department introduced M.Sc in Home Science Extension (1984), Ph.D (1989), 
M.Sc Food Science and Nutrition (2003), M.Phil in Food Science and Nutrition (2006) 
B.Sc Textiles and Fashion Design (2012) and M.Sc Textiles and Fashion Design (2018). 
The Department has generated Rs.83.5 Lakhs through funded research projects in the last 
five years. The Department is working towards empowerment of women and children 
through research, training and extension. A Day Care Center for children is managed by the 
Department. The faculty members of the department are serving in various committees at 
State and Central Level.

units.name: Department of Computer Science & Applications
units.title: Department of Computer Science & Applications — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Department of Computer Science & Applications — School of Computer Science & Technologies. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile: Established in the year 1996, the Department of Computer Science and Applications has emerged as a pioneer in imparting Higher Education on Computer Science among the rural students in this part of the country. The Department has highly qualified faculty members with rich experience in teaching and research. The Department offers an undergraduate programme in B.Sc.(Computer Science) and a Post Graduate programme in Master of Computer Applications (M.C.A.)approved by AICTE. Both the programmes offered by the department lead to rewarding career opportunities. The department also offers Ph.D. Programme since 2000. Presently, 27research scholars are pursuing their doctoral degrees and 59 research scholars have been awarded so far. The thrust areas of research are Digital Image Processing, Medical Image Processing& Analysis, Parallel Computing, Artificial Intelligence & Deep learning, Internet of Things, Computer Networks, Software Engineering and Bio-informatics. The Department also offers Courses on Computer Science for all UG, PG, B.Voc. & Diploma programmes offered by the institute. The Faculty of the Department handle funded research projects by UGC, DST, ICMR, CSIR, RGNIYD, PMMMNMMTT and NCDC to the tune of nearly Rs. 4 Crores. In recognition of its research credentials, the Department has received funds under UGC-Special Assistance Programme (SAP) and DST-FIST Level-I. To disseminate the knowledge on Computer Science, the Department has successfully organized a Refresher Course and 17 Conferences/Workshops at the National and International Level. The faculty members of the department have published 22 books, 06 patents and more than 600 research articles in refereed journals and books chapters till now. As part of its Extension activities, the Department promotes Computer Literacy and Cyber Awareness among the Teachers& Students of Rural Schools and village populace. It is also involved in devising and developing Mobile and IoT based Applications for rural development.

units.title: Centre for Rural Technology — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Centre for Rural Technology — School of Computer Science & Technologies. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile: The Rural Technology Centre was established as the Technical Wing of the GRI in the year 1988 with the major objectives of Developing Technologies for rural upliftment through innovative approaches and to offer Academic programmes. The Centre initially offered B.Sc. programmes in Rural Technology (1994-2005) and B.Sc. Sustainable Technology Management (2002-2005). From the year 2005-06, the centre has been offering an innovative technical progamme namely B.Tech in Civil Engineering (Habitat Development). The centre is actively involved in research in the areas of Cost-effective Building Technologies, Habitat Issues, Rural Housing and Models.

units.name: Centre for Rural Energy
units.title: Centre for Rural Energy — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Centre for Rural Energy — School of Computer Science & Technologies. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
Rural Energy Centre (REC) of Gandhigram Rural University was set up in 1998 with the following Vision and Mission.
Vision
To become a Center of Excellence in teaching, research & extension in energy area for sustainable rural development
Mission
To establish a model “energy village” with renewable energy & energy conservation technologies.

units.name: Centre for Applied Geology
units.title: Centre for Applied Geology — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: Centre for Applied Geology — School of Computer Science & Technologies. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile: Geological sciences is one of the important and vital disciplines for rural development. Therefore, the Institute has created the “Centre for Applied Geology” on 19th January 2012. The Centre uses space and spatial technologies on its own and in collaboration with other centers and departments of the GRI, in the areas like inventory of rural mineral resources and brings out the options for mineral resources for mineral based rural industries; rural water management modeling including village wise surface water resources estimation, water quality forecasting model for the water bodies using satellite infrared data, reservoir siltation and preventive land management plans, surface water quality monitoring including pollution through satellite data, village wise ground water targeting and budgeting, artificial recharge models etc; oil and gas exploration; inventory and mapping of hot water springs etc. In Addition the center will also work on riverine, coastal and arid systems to develop ecosystem based development of model for rural areas models. The center is also engaged in research to bring out disaster protective and preventive rural development plans to combat Earthquake, Landslide, Tsunami, Flood and other disasters.

units.title: School of Agriculture & Animal Sciences — The Gandhigram Rural Institute
units.description: School of Agriculture & Animal Sciences — School of Agriculture & Animal Sciences. The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Gandhigram, Dindigul, Tamil Nadu.
units.profile:
Established in the year 1956, the School of Agriculture and Animal Sciences, strives to produce man power 
with knowledge and skill in Agriculture, Horticulture, Dairy Science, and Seed Technology. Its academic, 
research and extension activities aim at spreading new technologies in Farming, Cattle Management, Seed 
Production and Preservation. The thrust areas include Indigenous Knowledge, Bio-fuel Promotion, Better 
Farming and Farm Technology Transfer, Agro-Engineering and Organic Farming and Sustainable 
Agriculture.

Computer Centre established in the year 1989 is the Central hub for ICT related services for our institute. Through Campus Wide LAN 838 nodes are connected using more than 100 switches, OFC and UTP cables.
